name: Researching the Corruption
summary: In Auberdine, Gershala Nightwhisper seeks corrupted brain stems from Blackfathom Deeps. Blood elves across the sea are said to be turning to demonic magic. He hopes the naga and satyr can teach him how to keep history from repeating itself.

sections.title: A Warning from History
sections.body: Night elves across Kalimdor still remember the ruin of their ancient kin. Ten thousand years ago, the Highborne gave in to demonic energies and became satyrs or naga. Now the high elves call themselves blood elves and embrace dark magic. Gershala Nightwhisper sees the old disaster taking shape again.

sections.title: Into the Deeps
sections.body: Blackfathom Deeps gives Gershala a place to study the corruption. Its temple ruins lie beneath the Zoram Strand in Ashenvale, where satyr cultists and naga dwell. He asks you to gather brain stems from both. He hopes to trace the link between arcane addiction, demonic corruption, and the body's ruin.

sections.title: A Desperate Cure
sections.body: Gershala studies the body in hopes of preventing another fall. The shared mutations of satyrs and naga may show him how to draw the blood elves back from damnation. Can research in Darkshore sway the desperate elves of Quel'Thalas? The answer remains uncertain.

faq.q: Why does Gershala Nightwhisper care about the blood elves?
faq.answer: Gershala fears the blood elves' turn to demonic powers could create another race of twisted monsters. Elven hubris once gave rise to the satyrs and naga.

faq.q: Where do you gather the corrupted brain stems?
faq.answer: Gather brain stems from satyrs and naga in Blackfathom Deeps. The ancient temple complex lies beneath the Zoram Strand on Ashenvale's northwest coast.

faq.q: Why does he specifically want satyr and naga samples?
faq.answer: Satyrs and naga both began as elves warped by unnatural forces. Satyrs were changed by demonic bargains, while the Sundering made the naga. Gershala compares their brain mutations to learn how dark power harms elven bodies.

faq.q: Who leads you to this task?
faq.answer: An introductory trail called The Corruption Abroad can lead you to Gershala Nightwhisper in Auberdine. He can also offer the investigation directly.

faq.q: What does Gershala plan to do with the specimens?
faq.answer: Gershala plans to compare the bodily effects of the two corruptions. He hopes what he learns can slow the blood elves' descent into monstrosity.

faq.q: Is Auberdine directly threatened by Blackfathom Deeps?
faq.answer: Blackfathom Deeps lies just across Ashenvale's southern border. The night elves of Auberdine watch the coast for signs of worsening demonic and Twilight corruption.

angles.text: As a night elf, you live with a wound still fresh in your people's memory. Your kin became the satyrs and naga who plague Kalimdor.
As a druid, you feel revulsion toward satyrs. Their fel corruption defiles the natural dream and warps the land.
As a mage, you see the bodily and spiritual cost of reckless dependence on magic.
As an Alliance member, you hear reports of blood elves turning to dark arts across the sea. You fear a new demonic threat.
